label: Adapt to the brief
intent: Choose a coherent treatment from the actual footage and user goal, not a generic effects demo.
pacing: Preserve meaning and complete spoken thoughts.
sceneBrief: Only propose a generated diagram or visual explanation if existing footage/text cannot carry the idea.
avoid: Do not force a transition, look, generated scene or paid action into every edit.

label: Restrained cinematic film
intent: Coherent color, motivated shot changes and enough space for significant moments.
pacing: Measured holds; cuts for continuity, dissolves for deliberate time/emotion changes.
sceneBrief: A quiet editorial opener with a clear subject, a controlled reveal, a stable reading hold and a restrained exit.
avoid: Do not duplicate grain/vignette already in the chosen look, add letterboxing automatically, or fake slow motion.

label: Readable mobile social edit
intent: A truthful immediate hook, concise beats and captions readable on mobile.
pacing: Compact meaningful beats; retain enough reading time and complete thoughts.
sceneBrief: A portrait comparison or process diagram with one clear hierarchy and text outside platform overlay zones.
avoid: No fabricated transcript, engagement claims, constant punch zooms or automatic strobe effects.

label: Clear step-by-step tutorial
intent: Prioritize demonstration detail, logical order and intelligible narration.
pacing: Hold until each real action is understandable; use cuts and labeled chapter boundaries.
sceneBrief: A truthful step diagram with consistent labels and a stable hold for reading, using supplied values only.
avoid: Do not use heavy blur/grade that hides evidence, replace real steps with invented ones, or move text constantly.

label: Minimal clean edit
intent: Let actual media and message lead with clean cuts and restrained text.
pacing: Only necessary edits; no gratuitous transition or animation.
sceneBrief: Prefer ordinary text over a generated scene unless a diagram is genuinely necessary.
avoid: Minimal does not mean removing requested captions, accessibility support or meaningful context.

label: Natural documentary
intent: Preserve real-world context, credible chronology and natural source sound.
pacing: Complete statements with contextual cutaways; transitions should clarify time or location.
sceneBrief: A clearly labeled schematic timeline or map using only verified places, dates and claims.
avoid: Do not fabricate factual footage, quotations or causal relationships; cleanup must not be claimed without inspection.

label: Warm travel journal
intent: Connect real locations, atmosphere and supplied personal observations.
pacing: Alternate establishing views with detail; let meaningful ambient sound breathe.
sceneBrief: A schematic journey path and supplied place names with a coherent warm palette and no external map requests.
avoid: Do not invent locations or turn every boundary into a light leak.

label: Clean product showcase
intent: Make the supplied product visible and its user-provided benefits easy to understand.
pacing: Intentional reveal, readable benefit hold and concise call to action.
sceneBrief: Show supplied product images as real attachments, preserve logo/aspect/alpha, and use a restrained reveal and a stable supplied benefit label.
avoid: Do not invent product evidence, numerical claims, brand assets or guarantees; food/beauty looks only fit corresponding content.

label: Monochrome noir
intent: Deliberate black-and-white contrast, negative space and restrained typography.
pacing: Measured tension, intentional holds and motivated cuts.
sceneBrief: A high-contrast graphic composition with one strong subject and readable supplied copy, not an invented crime narrative.
avoid: Do not obscure evidence, crush essential detail or add genre claims not present in the brief.

label: Intentional analog nostalgia
intent: A coherent tape/home-movie treatment rather than arbitrary digital damage.
pacing: Journal-like beats with occasional supported tape or film punctuation.
sceneBrief: A restrained period-inspired graphic using supplied copy and media, with static readable text and limited texture.
avoid: Inspect the look first to avoid duplicate damage; no uncontrolled flicker, fake archival claims or unrequested aspect-ratio changes.

label: Neon technical direction
intent: Purposeful magenta/cyan or controlled neon emphasis where it supports the subject.
pacing: Clear beats with brief deliberate graphic/digital junctions.
sceneBrief: A legible procedural technical diagram, supplied labels and a controlled neon palette; no external assets or fabricated data.
avoid: Do not replace reading time with noise, make every frame glitch, or add strobe as a default.

label: Soft dreamlike atmosphere
intent: Soft transitions, controlled glow and a coherent gentle palette.
pacing: Breathing room with motivated gradual reveals.
sceneBrief: A restrained atmospheric illustration with a clear focal point and enough stable time for supplied copy.
avoid: Do not double-apply bloom, make captions unreadable or imply generated imagery is documentary footage.

label: Focused sports energy
intent: Emphasize real action, readable subject tracking and authentic result/context.
pacing: Action-led short beats with longer holds for results or essential explanation.
sceneBrief: A supplied score/stat graphic with consistent scales, truthful numbers and a stable hold, not fabricated performance evidence.
avoid: Do not fake slow motion/frame rate, crop away decisive action or add continuous shake/flashes.
